scenarios.name: Hand-written SQL
scenarios.description: The same weekly mean as one DuckDB GROUP BY, results read into memory. The floor for 'query the store yourself'.

scenarios.name: Cold · raw fetch
scenarios.description: Empty cache, no pushdown: every raw row is read into Meridian, then resampled in the engine.

scenarios.name: Cold · pushdown
scenarios.description: Empty cache, resample pushed into SQL: one row per entity-week leaves DuckDB.

scenarios.name: Cold · pushdown · Europe/London
scenarios.description: As cold-pushdown, but weeks drawn in London time: the UTC→local conversion happens inside DuckDB.

scenarios.name: Warm · cached
scenarios.description: The identical report again: served from Meridian's cache, the source is not touched.

scenarios.name: Warm · +1 entity
scenarios.description: The cached report plus one new entity: only the newcomer is fetched, the rest merge from cache.

scenarios.name: Warm · 1 entity changed
scenarios.description: A write invalidates one entity; the next run refetches just that entity's slice.

scenarios.name: Cold · 28-day rolling mean
scenarios.description: A longitudinal calc SQL makes awkward: daily means pushed down, then a per-entity 28-day rolling mean in the engine.
